summary: NOTE AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, provides electronics manufacturing services in Western Europe and internationally. The company offers manufacturing engineering services in close collaboration with customers, such as component selection, developing test equipment, prototyping, and serial production. It also produces PCBAs, subassemblies, and box build products. In addition, the company provides contract manufacturing, and after-sales services. It serves its products to security and defence, medtech, greentech, industrial, and communication industries. NOTE AB (publ) was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
